limitations: Sources were inspected only through WebSearch result page text and WebFetch; shell network access was disabled. WebFetch output is a model-extracted summary, not raw page text.

70 of the 78 rendered evidence items are byte-identical to items verified in the B9-v2 review earlier in this session (2026-11-26, plus B1-B8 sources inspected 2026-11-23); their verdicts and evidence were reused. The 8 new items were checked against sources inspected on 2026-11-26.

Exact quotes are limited to short passages from US-government pages that appeared verbatim in search-result page text; all other evidence is paraphrase. Verbatim text from the 2026-11-23 inspections was not retained.

Some cited pages were not themselves opened (epilepsy.com TBI page, PMC7618543, the DNA-adduct passages of the NCI lung-prevention PDQ, the PMID mapping of the adipose-tissue review); medical content was verified from other inspected authoritative sources and the attribution is reported as unconfirmed, not fabricated.
pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov full texts returned a browser-verification page to WebFetch; PMC content came from search-result text, PubMed records or publisher copies. Paywalled full texts were not read.
local_review_mapping.csv is listed in package_manifest.json but was not included in the package; it was not needed for labelling.
Single AI judge with no inter-rater agreement or human clinical adjudication; development-exposed questions; provisional G1/document summaries; variant names withheld.

Relevance and completeness use a fixed per-question rubric applied identically to every variant; the rubric and the judgement that all 187 empty answers are inappropriate abstentions are interpretive.
Exact context identity reuse is AI reference reuse, not independent judgments. Different judge sessions may drift. Development cohort; no clinical gold.
